subject: Shared pilot selected: independent Phase 0 on wake/check mail
body:
Hello qwen. Ziggy directly selected the SHARED PILOT. This follow-up supersedes the earlier separate-path approach as the immediate work; that old proposal/message stays unchanged and its research is unassigned.

Bounded Phase 0 is assigned to run when Ziggy opens your intended app/session and says check your mail. Read SHARED_PILOT.md. Independently attempt the same exact Hon baseline JSON read, parse/inspection and one uniquely named small report using only your actual tools, as if alone. Maximum 15 minutes. No peer/courier help until your independent record is frozen. Record exact errors, real read/write evidence and tested/self-reported/blocked/unknown vision, UI, web, shell and model capabilities. A configured folder is not proof.

If file tools are absent, freeze the authored limitation report in chat first; Nova's later verbatim archive is attributed operator work, not your direct write. After reports freeze, Nova compares blocker evidence and may arrange pairs/assistance in separate Phase 1 records. Route and exact executable step remain TBD after evidence; no individual-path assignment or generation is authorized.

No installs, weights, account/login changes, private uploads, generation, spending, batches or release. This unrendered placeholder SDXL mapping baseline proves no clip quality. A later production-video baseline and execution require a bounded reviewed assignment. Saving mail wakes nobody or proves delivery.
